Leg 01 · Fri 27 Nov 2026

Three cities, one destination

Our teams from Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi and Hai Phong all fly into Cam Ranh International Airport, the gateway to Nha Trang.

Leg 02 · Day 1 · Fri 27 Nov 2026

Hello, Nha Trang

After landing, our bus picks everyone up at Cam Ranh, stops at two of the city's landmarks, then takes us to the hotel.

  1. —
    Bus from Cam Ranh Airport into Nha TrangOur bus meets everyone at arrivals, then drives the coast road over the Cù Hin pass

  3. —
    Visit Po Nagar Cham TowersCham temples from the 8th–13th century
  4. —

Leg 04 · Day 2 · Sat 28 Nov 2026

Team building on Bãi Sỏi

One team, one boat. Through beach games and team challenges we get to know colleagues from every office, cheer each other on, and show how strong SKR & HAL are when we pull together.

  • Connect
  • Trust
  • Teamwork
  • Win together
  1. 08:00
    Bus from the hotel to Cầu Đá pier

Leg 05 · Day 2 · Noon & afternoon

Lunch at Làng Chài, then the Floating Bar

After a seafood lunch at Làng Chài, the speedboats take us out to the Floating Bar on the open sea near the islands, where everyone joins the fun right on the water.

  1. —
    Lunch at Làng ChàiFresh seafood on the floating rafts
  2. —
    Speedboat to the Floating BarKayaking, swimming, water games, music and drinks out on the bay
